weapon.d: Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1). If a bonus granted by a skill like Rally or Hone and/or 1 extra space of movement granted by a skill like Armor March or Armored Boots is active on foe, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+4 to unit during combat and foe cannot make a follow-up attack.

special.d: Before combat this unit initiates, foes in an area near target take damage equal to (unit's Atk minus foe's Def or Res).
Before combat this unit initiates, foes in an area near target take damage equal to 1.5 x (unit's Atk minus foe's Def or Res).

b.d: If unit’s HP ≤ 30%, unit can move to a space adjacent to any ally.
If unit’s HP ≤ 40%, unit can move to a space adjacent to any ally.
If unit’s HP ≤ 50%, unit can move to a space adjacent to any ally.

c.d: Allies within 2 spaces gain: "If foe uses sword, lance, axe, dragonstone, or beast damage, grants Def/Res+2 during combat."
Allies within 2 spaces gain: "If foe uses sword, lance, axe, dragonstone, or beast damage, grants Def/Res+3 during combat."
Allies within 2 spaces gain: "If foe uses sword, lance, axe, dragonstone, or beast damage, grants Def/Res+4 during combat."
